g.text: Inside one DiT linear layer, one denoise step
same path for QKV, out-proj and MLP in every block; CFG cond + uncond rows carry the same adapter id
Y = X · Wᵀ (bf16 or FP8 W)
one GEMM for every row; W never modified
LoRA path (new kernel) · base rows (slot -1) exit early, zero cost
GPU HBM · stacked buffers, one pair per layer
A_stack [S, r_max, d_in] · B_stack [S, d_out, r_max] · ranks padded to buckets
async H2D on a side stream, overlaps the text-encoder stage
CPU pinned memory · LRU of hot adapters
# one torch custom op per linear → whole step stays one compiled graph
z = sgmm_shrink(x, A_stack, seg_start, slot_id) # [T, r_max]
sgmm_expand_add_(y, z, B_stack, seg_start, slot_id, scale)
# rows with slot_id == -1 skip both LoRA kernels
